Counsel for Applicant :- Narendra Gupta,Mohammad Salim Khan Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Karunesh Singh Pawar,J.

The applicant has moved the present application under Section 438 of Cr.P.C. praying for grant of anticipatory bail in Case Crime No.509 of 2021 under sections 406, 420, 467, 468, 471, 504, 506 I.P.C., P.S. Mishrikh, district Sitapur.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State.

It is alleged in the prosecution case that the complainant who gave his residential house for running office of the company on rent of Rs.4000/- per month for a period of three years was tempted by the accused persons with assurance that the money will be doubled in five years and will get interest at the rate of 11.5% per annum.
Relying on the assurance, the complainant deposited a huge amount in various accounts.
Some other persons also deposited the money in the company.
On a demand being raised, the complainant was mislead and he received rent only upto July, 2020.

It is submitted on behalf of the applicant that the applicant was appointed as Branch Manager in the company for running office.
The applicant is not beneficiary in any manner.
As per admitted case of the prosecution, the entire money has been deposited in the company.
The co-accused Nitin Kumar Srivastava who is the Director of the Company is the main accused and has committed the offence.
The applicant himself is the victim who has been cheated by the co-accused Nitin Kumar.
The applicant has no criminal antecedent.
The applicant shall cooperate in the investigation/trial.
Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer made by the applicant's counsel.

Without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case and considering the nature of accusation and the undertaking given on behalf of the applicant that he shall cooperate in the investigation/trial , the applicant is employed as Branch Manager in the Company, he has no criminal antecedent and gravity of offence, I am of the opinion that in the event of arrest, the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on anticipatory bail in this case in the light of judgment of Supreme Court in Sushila Aggarwal and others vs. State (NCT of Delhi) and another (2020)5 SCC 1,
subject to his cooperation in the investigation/trial.

sentences.text: The applicant shall cooperate in the investigation/trial and he will not influence the witnesses.

The accused-applicant will report to the police station concerned within 20 days from today and shall remain present as and when the arresting officer /I.O./ S.H.O. concerned call (s) for investigation/interrogation.
The applicant shall not leave India without previous permission of the Court.
In case of default, it would be open for the investigating agency to move application for vacation of this order.
Further, in case the applicant does not report to the police station within 20 days from today, the protection granted by this court shall not be available to the applicant.
In view of the aforesaid, the anticipatory bail application is allowed.
